title: Zoo Ops [Hard]
tagline: A real service, real tickets. Find where the code goes.

levels.label: Cache
levels.title: ZOO-101 The Owl bill exploded
levels.without: Every question is paid again and visitors wait.
levels.with: Repeated questions come from the shared cache, instant and free.

levels.label: Rate limit
levels.title: ZOO-102 A pigeon flood took the kiosk down
levels.without: The pigeon swarm reaches the Owl, jams the kiosk and runs up the bill.
levels.with: Each caller has a shared budget, the swarm is throttled.

levels.label: Reliability
levels.title: ZOO-103 The storm on the bridge
levels.without: During the storm questions hang on the dead Owl, then fail.
levels.with: Deadlines, retries, a circuit breaker and the Parrot as backup.

levels.label: Idempotency
levels.title: ZOO-104 Animals are fed twice
levels.without: Network retries feed an animal two or three times.
levels.with: Each order is served once, retries replay the first response.

levels.label: Observability
levels.title: ZOO-105 We are flying blind
levels.without: No telemetry: bars and forecast hidden, no pager.
levels.with: Request ids, p95, burn-rate alerts: you see incidents coming.

levels.label: DB speed
levels.title: ZOO-106 The visitor guide is slow
levels.without: Every action lags by a second.
levels.with: Indexed, cursor-paginated, pooled: actions are instant.

levels.label: Integrity
levels.title: ZOO-107 Two families, one kitten
levels.without: Two families leave with the same kitten.
levels.with: ETags and transactions: one kitten, one family.

levels.label: Async
levels.title: ZOO-108 The robot crew is stuck
levels.without: Silent waits, and you clean every pen by hand.
levels.with: The Owl streams, the robots retry later, poison jobs are parked.

levels.label: Auth
levels.title: ZOO-109 A raccoon read our data
levels.without: The raccoon walks in with a forged badge and steals coins.
levels.with: Signed tokens, hashed keys, tenant isolation.

levels.label: Deploy
levels.title: ZOO-110 Release day
levels.without: A bad release breaks the kiosk for everyone.
levels.with: Drain on shutdown, sticky canary, automatic rollback.
